_comment: Copied to .specify/extensions/mbd-trace/trace-config.json. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_require_options: plan, model, code, tests, results (needs junit_globs), tasks_done
_model_json: pemb-imported models (pemb/imported/*.json); a plan Model Element must name a block path in one of them
_pemb: set pemb_src (path to pemb/src), pemb_trace_config (its trace.toml) and pemb_python (pemb's venv python) to add the full MBD trace check; it runs as a subprocess in pemb's own environment
